review.logic: Correct five-minute current-period match, human-verified simulation provenance, single source and medium risk.

review.unsupportedClaims: No false historical claim or notification guarantee. Generic arrive-early advice is not in the evidence; the passenger sentence about publishing only confirmed information should be framed as draft policy, not an organization commitment.
review.proposedFacts: No proposedFacts field; actions remain verification, monitoring, information preparation and drafts.
notes: Remove or clearly condition the unsupported generic extra-arrival-time advice.
Clarify that insufficient evidence for risk escalation does not prevent human referral.
Frame only-confirmed-publication wording as a draft restriction.
